title: Inspecter une proposition et sa preuve

actions.code: const x={{ json . }}; if(typeof x.proposal_id!=="string"||!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$/.test(x.proposal_id)) throw new Error("invalid_slug"); return x;

const p0={{ json .proposal_file }}; let p; try{p=typeof p0==="string"?JSON.parse(p0):JSON.parse(p0.content||JSON.stringify(p0))}catch(e){throw new Error("proposal_invalid")} if(p.proposal_id!==(({{ json .query }}).proposal_id)||typeof p.source_id!=="string"||!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$/.test(p.source_id)||p.status!=="proposed") throw new Error("proposal_corrupt_or_mismatch"); return p;

const p={{ json .proposal }}; const s0={{ json .source_file }}; const s=typeof s0==="string"?JSON.parse(s0):JSON.parse(s0.content||JSON.stringify(s0)); if(s.source_id!==p.source_id||!s.content.includes(p.evidence_quote)) throw new Error("evidence_or_source_mismatch"); return {proposal_id:p.proposal_id,title:p.title,content:p.content,evidence_quote:p.evidence_quote,source_id:p.source_id,source_ref:s.ref,source_content:s.content,review_due:p.review_due,status:p.status};
